title: Chipotle Compound Butter
summary: Soft butter with chipotle, adobo, and lime zest. A slice melts over hot steak. Optional alternative to chimichurri.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Mash everything together with a fork until evenly streaked orange.

steps.title: Roll and chill
steps.text: Roll into a log in plastic wrap or parchment and chill until firm enough to slice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Set a slice on each portion of hot steak right after slicing so it melts into the juices.

notes: Keeps a week in the fridge or months frozen. Good way to use up leftover chipotles from an open can. Also good on corn, sweet potatoes, or grilled chicken.
